title: Rama consoles Dasaratha
introduction: Rama comes to see his father Dasharatha and Dasharatha summons Sumantra to fetch all his wives to hither, and asks Rama to stay with him at least for a night. But Rama resolved in his vow, persuades his father to be peaceful. Dasharatha's anguish intensifies and he swoons at the departure of Rama.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अयोध्य काण्डे चतुर् त्रिंशः सर्गः

Thus completes 34th chapter of Ayodhya Kanda in glorious Ramayana, the work of a sage and the oldest epic. verses.devanagari:
ततःकमलपत्राक्षः श्यामो निरुपमो महान् |
उवाच रामस्तम् सूतं पितुराख्याहि मामिति
verses.iast:
tataḥkamalapatrākśaḥ śyāmo nirupamo mahān |
uvāca rāmastam sūtaṃ piturākhyāhi māmiti
verses.translation: Thereafter, the lotus-eyes Rama, who was dark-brown in complexion and great beyond compare, spoke thus to the charioteer, "Tell about me to my father."

verses.devanagari:
स राम प्रेषितः क्षिप्रम् सम्ताप कलुष इन्द्रियः |
प्रविश्य नृपतिम् सूतः निह्श्वसन्तम् ददर्श ह
verses.iast:
sa rāma preṣitaḥ kṣipram samtāpa kaluṣa indriyaḥ |
praviśya nṛpatim sūtaḥ nihśvasantam dadarśa ha
verses.translation: Quickly entering inside, when sent by Rama, the charioteer saw the king having sighs, his senses disturbed by grief.

glosses.meaning: with his senses disturbed by grief

verses.devanagari:
उपरक्तमिवादित्यं भस्मच्छन्नमिवानलम्|
तटाकमिव निस्तोयमपश्यज्जगतीपतिम्
verses.iast:
uparaktamivādityaṃ bhasmacchannamivānalam |
taṭākamiva nistoyamapaśyajjagatīpatim
verses.translation: He saw the king resembling an eclipsed sun, like fire covered by ash, as a lake without water.

verses.devanagari:
आलोक्य तु महा प्राज्ञः परम आकुल चेतसम् |
रामम् एव अनुशोचन्तम् सूतः प्रान्जलिर् आसदत्
verses.iast:
ālokya tu mahā prāGYaḥ parama ākula cetasam |
rāmam eva anuśocantam sūtaḥ prānjalir āsadat
verses.translation: The charioteer, a great intellectual, saw Dasaratha repenting with his mind greatly agitated and approached him with joined palms.

verses.devanagari:
तम् वर्धयित्वा राजानम् सूतः पूर्वम् जयाशिषा|
भयविक्लबया वाचा मन्दया श्लक्ष्णमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tam vardhayitvā rājānam sūtaḥ pūrvam jayāśiśhā |
bhayaviklabayā vācā mandayā ślakśṇamabravīt
verses.translation: The charioteer, first inspiring the king with blessings of triumph, spoke thus in a slow and sweet voice, overcome with fear.

verses.devanagari:
अयम् स पुरुष व्याघ्र द्वारि तिष्ठति ते सुतः |
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनम् दत्त्वा सर्वम् चैव उपजीविनाम्
verses.iast:
ayam sa puruṣa vyāghra dvāri tiṣṭhati te sutaḥ |
brāhmaṇebhyo dhanam dattvā sarvam caiva upajīvinām
verses.translation: "Your son, the tiger among men, having given away all his wealth to brahmanas and dependents, is waiting at the gate."

verses.devanagari:
स त्वा पश्यतु भद्रम् ते रामः सत्य पराक्रमः |
सर्वान् सुहृदाअपृच्च्य त्वाम् इदानीम् दिदृक्षते
verses.iast:
sa tvā paśyatu bhadram te rāmaḥ satya parākramaḥ |
sarvān suhṛdāapṛccya tvām idānīm didṛkṣate
verses.translation: "May auspiciousness betide you! Let that Rama, who is unfailingly brave, see you. After bidding farewell to all friends, he wants to see you now."

glosses.meaning: to you! saH raamaH = (let) that Rama

verses.devanagari:
गमिष्यति महा अरण्यम् तम् पश्य जगती पते |
वृतम् राज गुणैः सर्वैः आदित्यम् इव रश्मिभिः
verses.iast:
gamiṣyati mahā araṇyam tam paśya jagatī pate |
vṛtam rāja guṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ ādityam iva raśmibhiḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, king! Rama is setting out to a great forest. See him who is resembling a sun with rays of light, displaying royal qualities."

verses.devanagari:
स सत्य वादी धर्म आत्मा गाम्भीर्यात् सागर उपमः |
आकाशैव निष्पन्को नर इन्द्रः प्रत्युवाच तम्
verses.iast:
sa satya vādī dharma ātmā gāmbhīryāt sāgara upamaḥ |
ākāśaiva niṣpanko nara indraḥ pratyuvāca tam
verses.translation: That king Dasaratha, who speaks truth, whose mind is virtuous, who is like an ocean by his depth of character and who is blemish less like a sky, replied to Sumantra as follows:

verses.devanagari:
सुमन्त्र आनय मे दारान् ये केचित् इह मामकाः |
दारैः परिवृतः सर्वैः द्रष्टुम् इच्चामि राघवम्
verses.iast:
sumantra ānaya me dārān ye kecit iha māmakāḥ |
dāraiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ draṣṭum iccāmi rāghavam
verses.translation: "Oh, Sumantra! being all my wives, who are here. Surrounded by all of them, I want to see the virtuous Rama."

verses.devanagari:
सो अन्तः पुरम् अतीत्य एव स्त्रियः ता वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् |
आर्यो ह्वयति वो राजा गम्यताम् तत्र माचिरम्
verses.iast:
so antaḥ puram atītya eva striyaḥ tā vākyam abravīt |
āryo hvayati vo rājā gamyatām tatra māciram
verses.translation: Sumantra, after entering the gynaecium, spoke these words to those women as follows: "Oh, the venerable ladies! The king is calling you. Go there without delay.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ताः स्त्रियः सर्वाः सुमन्त्रेण नृप आज्ञया |
प्रचक्रमुस् तत् भवनम् भर्तुर् आज्ञाय शासनम्
verses.iast:
evam uktāḥ striyaḥ sarvāḥ sumantreṇa nṛpa āGYayā |
pracakramus tat bhavanam bhartur āGYāya śāsanam
verses.translation: All those women, asked thus by Sumantra as per the king's orders, went to his palace, after knowing the instructions of their husband.

verses.devanagari:
अर्ध सप्त शताः ताः तु प्रमदाः ताम्र लोचनाः |
कौसल्याम् परिवार्य अथ शनैः जग्मुर् धृत व्रताः
verses.iast:
ardha sapta śatāḥ tāḥ tu pramadāḥ tāmra locanāḥ |
kausalyām parivārya atha śanaiḥ jagmur dhṛta vratāḥ
verses.translation: Encircling Kausalya, three hundred fifty women, steadfast in their vow(of devotion to their husband), with their eyes reddened, went there slowly.

glosses.meaning: steadfast in their vow (of devotion to their husband)

verses.devanagari:
आगतेषु च दारेषु समवेक्ष्य मही पतिः |
उवाच राजा तम् सूतम् सुमन्त्र आनय मे सुतम्
verses.iast:
āgateṣu ca dāreṣu samavekṣya mahī patiḥ |
uvāca rājā tam sūtam sumantra ānaya me sutam
verses.translation: After arrival of his wives, king Dasaratha spoke to that charioteer as follows, "Oh, Sumantra! Bring my son here."

verses.devanagari:
स सूतः रामम् आदाय लक्ष्मणम् मैथिलीम् तदा |
जगाम अभिमुखः तूर्णम् सकाशम् जगती पतेः
verses.iast:
sa sūtaḥ rāmam ādāya lakṣmaṇam maithilīm tadā |
jagāma abhimukhaḥ tūrṇam sakāśam jagatī pateḥ
verses.translation: Taking Rama, Lakshmana and Seetha, that charioteer then speedily went to the king's presence.

verses.devanagari:
स राजा पुत्रम् आयान्तम् दृष्ट्वा दूरात् कृत अन्जलिम् |
उत्पपात आसनात् तूर्णम् आर्तः स्त्री जन सम्वृतः
verses.iast:
sa rājā putram āyāntam dṛṣṭvā dūrāt kṛta anjalim |
utpapāta āsanāt tūrṇam ārtaḥ strī jana samvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: King Dasaratha surrounded by women, seeing from a distance his son coming with folded hands, distressed as he was, rose swiftly from his seat.

verses.devanagari:
सो अभिदुद्राव वेगेन रामम् दृष्ट्वा विशाम् पतिः |
तम् असम्प्राप्य दुह्ख आर्तः पपात भुवि मूर्चितः
verses.iast:
so abhidudrāva vegena rāmam dṛṣṭvā viśām patiḥ |
tam asamprāpya duhkha ārtaḥ papāta bhuvi mūrcitaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing Rama, King Dasaratha ran speedily towards him. But without reaching him he fell on the floor senseless, afflicted as he was with sorrow.

verses.devanagari:
तम् रामः अभ्यपातत् क्षिप्रम् लक्ष्मणः च महा रथः |
विसम्ज्ञम् इव दुह्खेन सशोकम् नृपतिम् तदा
verses.iast:
tam rāmaḥ abhyapātat kṣipram lakṣmaṇaḥ ca mahā rathaḥ |
visamGYam iva duhkhena saśokam nṛpatim tadā
verses.translation: Then, Rama and Lakshmana an eminent car-warrior, quickly approached that king who seemed unconscious with full of grief as he was, through agony.

verses.devanagari:
स्त्री सहस्र निनादः च सम्जज्ञे राज वेश्मनि |
हाहा राम इति सहसा भूषण ध्वनि मूर्चितः
verses.iast:
strī sahasra ninādaḥ ca samjaGYe rāja veśmani |
hāhā rāma iti sahasā bhūṣaṇa dhvani mūrcitaḥ
verses.translation: Sounds of thousands of women crying "Alas! Alas! Oh Rama!" generated all at once from the royal palace, mixed with the sound of tinkling ornaments.

glosses.meaning: sound of thousands of women crying
"Alas! Alas! Oh Rama !" bhuushhaNa dhvanimuurchhitaH = mixed with the sound of tinkling of ornaments.

verses.devanagari:
तम् परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्याम् ताव् उभौ राम लक्ष्मणौ |
पर्यन्के सीतया सार्धम् रुदन्तः समवेशयन्
verses.iast:
tam pariṣvajya bāhubhyām tāv ubhau rāma lakṣmaṇau |
paryanke sītayā sārdham rudantaḥ samaveśayan
verses.translation: Holding Dasaratha in their arms and crying, both Rama and Lakshmana along with Seetha laid him on the couch.

verses.devanagari:
अथ रामः मुहूर्तेन लब्ध सम्ज्ञम् मही पतिम् |
उवाच प्रान्जलिर् भूत्वा शोक अर्णव परिप्लुतम्
verses.iast:
atha rāmaḥ muhūrtena labdha samGYam mahī patim |
uvāca prānjalir bhūtvā śoka arṇava pariplutam
verses.translation: Then, Rama with folded hands spoke thus to king Dasaratha who got consciousness within a short time and who was inundated in a sea of sorrow.

glosses.meaning: spoke(as follows) mahiipatim = to king Dasaratha
imundated in a sea of sorrow.

verses.devanagari:
आपृच्चे त्वाम् महा राज सर्वेषाम् ईश्वरः असि नः |
प्रस्थितम् दण्डक अरण्यम् पश्य त्वम् कुशलेन माम्
verses.iast:
āpṛcce tvām mahā rāja sarveṣām īśvaraḥ asi naḥ |
prasthitam daṇḍaka araṇyam paśya tvam kuśalena mām
verses.translation: "Oh, emperor! I take leave of you, who are the lord of all of us. See auspiciously towards me, who am about to leave for Dandaka forest."

glosses.meaning: Oh Emperor! aapR^ichchhe = I am seaking permission

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणम् च अनुजानीहि सीता च अन्वेति माम् वनम् |
कारणैः बहुभिस् तथ्यैः वार्यमाणौ न च इच्चतः
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇam ca anujānīhi sītā ca anveti mām vanam |
kāraṇaiḥ bahubhis tathyaiḥ vāryamāṇau na ca iccataḥ
verses.translation: "Permit Lakshmana also and Seetha too who is accompanying me to the forest. Even if prevented(by me0 on many true reasons, these two are not agreeing to stay behind"

verses.devanagari:
अनुजानीहि सर्वान् नः शोकम् उत्सृज्य मानद |
लक्ष्मणम् माम् च सीताम् च प्रजापतिर् इव प्रजाः
verses.iast:
anujānīhi sarvān naḥ śokam utsṛjya mānada |
lakṣmaṇam mām ca sītām ca prajāpatir iva prajāḥ
verses.translation: "Giving up grief, Oh the bestower of honour, grant leave to all of us, Lakshmana myself and Seetha as Brahma(the lord of creation) did to his sons(sanaka and his three brothers who intended to go to forest for practising austerities)."

verses.devanagari:
प्रतीक्षमाणम् अव्यग्रम् अनुज्ञाम् जगती पतेः |
उवाच रर्जा सम्प्रेक्ष्य वन वासाय राघवम्
verses.iast:
pratīkṣamāṇam avyagram anuGYām jagatī pateḥ |
uvāca rarjā samprekṣya vana vāsāya rāghavam
verses.translation: Gazing at Rama who is unruffled, awaiting permission of the king for stay in the forest, the king Dasaratha spoke thus:

verses.devanagari:
अहम् राघव कैकेय्या वर दानेन मोहितः |
अयोध्यायाः त्वम् एव अद्य भव राजा निगृह्य माम्
verses.iast:
aham rāghava kaikeyyā vara dānena mohitaḥ |
ayodhyāyāḥ tvam eva adya bhava rājā nigṛhya mām
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! I was stupefied by Kaikeyi through a boon. Now, by confining me, be you the king of Ayodhya."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः नृपतिना रामः धर्मभृताम् वरः |
प्रत्युवाच अन्जलिम् कृत्वा पितरम् वाक्य कोविदः
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ nṛpatinā rāmaḥ dharmabhṛtām varaḥ |
pratyuvāca anjalim kṛtvā pitaram vākya kovidaḥ
verses.translation: When told thus by the king, Rama the best man in supporting righteousness and who is proficient in expression, replied( as follows) to his father, after making salutation with joined palms.

glosses.meaning: after making salutation with joined palms.

verses.devanagari:
भवान् वर्ष सहस्राय पृथिव्या नृपते पतिः |
अहम् तु अरण्ये वत्स्यामि न मे कार्यम् त्वया अनृतम्
verses.iast:
bhavān varṣa sahasrāya pṛthivyā nṛpate patiḥ |
aham tu araṇye vatsyāmi na me kāryam tvayā anṛtam
verses.translation: "Oh, king! You be the ruler of the earth for thousand years. But, I for my part, will stay in the forest. For my sake, do not generate untruth about you."

glosses.meaning: shall stay arNye = in the forest

verses.devanagari:
नव पञ्च च वर्षाणि वनवासे विहृत्य ते |
पुनः पादौ ग्रहीष्यामि प्रतिज्ञान्ते नराधिपः
verses.iast:
nava paJṇca ca varśhāṇi vanavāse vihṛtya te |
punaḥ pādau grahīśhyāmi pratijJṇānte narādhipaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, ruler of men! Having strolled in the forest for fourteen years, I shall clasp your feet once more after fulfilling my promise."

verses.devanagari:
रुदन्नाह प्रियम् पुत्रं सत्यपाशेन संयतः |
कैकेय्या चोद्यमान्स्तु मिथो राजा तमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
rudannāha priyam putraṃ satyapāśena saṃyataḥ |
kaikeyyā codyamānstu mitho rājā tamabravīt
verses.translation: Prompted secretly by kaikeyi, the distressed king, tied up by fetters of truth, said weeping to that beloved son.

verses.devanagari:
श्रेयसे वृद्धये तात पुनर् आगमनाय च |
गच्चस्व अरिष्टम् अव्यग्रः पन्थानम् अकुतः भयम्
verses.iast:
śreyase vṛddhaye tāta punar āgamanāya ca |
gaccasva ariṣṭam avyagraḥ panthānam akutaḥ bhayam
verses.translation: "Oh, darling! Proceed for welfare, for advancement and for coming again. Let your path of travel be auspicious, undistracted and fearless from any quarter."

verses.devanagari:
न हि सत्यात्मनस्तात धर्माभिमनसस्तव |
विनिवर्त यितुं बुद्धि शक्यते रघुनन्दन
verses.iast:
na hi satyātmanastāta dharmābhimanasastava |
vinivarta yituṃ buddhi śakyate raghunandana
verses.translation: "Oh, darling, the seion of Raghu! Truthful as you are by nature and your mind being given to righteousness, your decision cannot be reversed."

glosses.meaning: your mind being given to righteousness

verses.devanagari:
अद्य तु इदानीम् रजनीम् पुत्र मा गच्च सर्वथा |
मातरम् माम् च सम्पश्यन् वस इमाम् अद्य शर्वरीम्
verses.iast:
adya tu idānīm rajanīm putra mā gacca sarvathā |
mātaram mām ca sampaśyan vasa imām adya śarvarīm
verses.translation: "Oh, son! Do not leave in any case today, now at night time. Even by seeing you for one day, I may live happily."

glosses.meaning: even by seeing for one day

verses.devanagari:
मातरं माम् च सम्पश्यन् वसेमामद्य शर्वरीम् |
तर्पितः सर्वकामैस्त्वम् स्वः काले साधयिष्यसि
verses.iast:
mātaraṃ mām ca sampaśyan vasemāmadya śarvarīm |
tarpitaḥ sarvakāmaistvam svaḥ kāle sādhayiśhyasi
verses.translation: "Looking at your mother and myself, stay at least for this night today. Satiated by all the desired objects, you may leave tomorrow at dawn."

verses.devanagari:
दुष्करम् क्रियते पुत्र सर्वथा राघव तया |
मत्प्रियार्थम् प्रियांस्त्यक्त्वा यद्यासि विजनम् वनम्
verses.iast:
duśhkaram kriyate putra sarvathā rāghava tayā |
matpriyārtham priyāṃstyaktvā yadyāsi vijanam vanam
verses.translation: "Oh Rama, my son! An incorrigible thing is being done by you since for my pleasure you are going to the forest a solitary place, leaving beloved ones."

verses.devanagari:
न चैतन्मे प्रियम् पुत्र शपे सत्येन राघव |
छन्नया छलितस्त्वस्नु स्त्रुया छन्नाग्निकल्पया
verses.iast:
na caitanme priyam putra śape satyena rāghava |
channayā chalitastvasnu struyā channāgnikalpayā
verses.translation: "Oh Rama my son! Your exile is not agreeable to me. I was cheated by Kaikeyi who had concealed intentions and resembled fire with ashes."

verses.devanagari:
पञ्चना या तु लब्धा मे तां त्वम् निस्तर्तुमिच्छसि |
अनया वृत्तसादिन्या कैकेय्याऽभिप्रचोदितः
verses.iast:
paJṇcanā yā tu labdhā me tāṃ tvam nistartumicchasi |
anayā vṛttasādinyā kaikeyyā'bhipracoditaḥ
verses.translation: Incited by Kaikeyi who has destroyed established customs, you wish to redeem my deceit, derived by me from her.

verses.devanagari:
न चैतदाश्चर्यतमम् यत्तज्ज्येष्ठस्सुतो मम |
अपानृतकथम् पुत्र पितरम् कर्तुमिच्छ्सि
verses.iast:
na caitadāścaryatamam yattajjyeśhṭhassuto mama |
apānṛtakatham putra pitaram kartumicchsi
verses.translation: "It is not a great surprise, my son, that you my eldest son should seek to make your father as one who does not have false promises."

glosses.meaning: as on ewho does not have false promises
is not aashcharyatamam = a great surprise.

verses.devanagari:
अथ रामः तथा श्रुत्वा पितुर् आर्तस्य भाषितम् |
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा दीनो वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
atha rāmaḥ tathā śrutvā pitur ārtasya bhāṣitam |
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā dīno vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: After hearing these words of their father who was depressed, Rama and Lakshmana were upset. Then Rama spoke these words.

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्स्यामि यान् अद्य गुणान् को मे श्वस्तान् प्रदास्यति |
अपक्रमणम् एव अतः सर्व कामैः अहम् वृणे
verses.iast:
prāpsyāmi yān adya guṇān ko me śvastān pradāsyati |
apakramaṇam eva ataḥ sarva kāmaiḥ aham vṛṇe
verses.translation: Even if these worldly pleasures are obtained today, who will offer those things to me tomorrow? Therefore I desire only to get away in lieu of all these enjoyments.

glosses.meaning: wordly pleasures praapsyaami = I can get

verses.devanagari:
इयम् सराष्ट्रा सजना धन धान्य समाकुला |
मया विसृष्टा वसुधा भरताय प्रदीयताम्
verses.iast:
iyam sarāṣṭrā sajanā dhana dhānya samākulā |
mayā visṛṣṭā vasudhā bharatāya pradīyatām
verses.translation: "This earth being relinquished by me; which included various provinces, filled with people, imbued with riches and food grains, may be given to Bharata."

verses.devanagari:
वनवासकृता बुद्धिर्न च मेऽद्य चलिष्यति |
यस्तुष्टेन वरो दत्तः कैकेय्यै वरद त्वया
दीयताम् निखिलेनैव सत्यस्त्वम् भव पार्थिव |
verses.iast:
vanavāsakṛtā buddhirna ca me'dya caliśhyati |
yastuśhṭena varo dattaḥ kaikeyyai varada tvayā
dīyatām nikhilenaiva satyastvam bhava pārthiva |
verses.translation: "I cannot budge now from my decision made about my stay in the forest. Oh king the bestower of boons! You were pleased to give a boon to Kaikeyi and let it be fulfilled completely. Be you a truthful man."

glosses.meaning: made about my stay in the forest
the bestower of boons! tvayaa = by you

verses.devanagari:
अहम् निदेशम् भवतो यथोक्तमनुपालयन्
चतुर्दश समा वत्स्ये वने वनचरैः सह |
verses.iast:
aham nideśam bhavato yathoktamanupālayan
caturdaśa samā vatsye vane vanacaraiḥ saha |
verses.translation: "I , as promised, fulfilling your command, shall live in the forest along with forest-dwellers for fourteen years."

verses.devanagari:
मा विमर्शो वसुमती भरताय प्रदीयताम्
न हि मे काम्क्षितम् राज्यम् सुखमात्मनि वा प्रियम् |
यथा निदेशम् कर्तुम् वै तवैव रघुनन्धन
verses.iast:
mā vimarśo vasumatī bharatāya pradīyatām
na hi me kāmkśitam rājyam sukhamātmani vā priyam |
yathā nideśam kartum vai tavaiva raghunandhana
verses.translation: "Oh, king! Do not have any hesitation in offering the kingdom to Bharata. Neither kingdom nor happiness indeed is desired by my nature. It is dear to me only to do your command as directed."

verses.devanagari:
अपगच्चतु ते दुह्खम् मा भूर् बाष्प परिप्लुतः |
न हि क्षुभ्यति दुर्धर्षः समुद्रः सरिताम् पतिः
verses.iast:
apagaccatu te duhkham mā bhūr bāṣpa pariplutaḥ |
na hi kṣubhyati durdharṣaḥ samudraḥ saritām patiḥ
verses.translation: "Let your sorrow disappear! Do not be overwhelmed with tears. The ocean, the lord of rivers which is difficult to assail, indeed does not get agitated."

glosses.meaning: let your sorrow disappear! maa bhuuH = do not be

verses.devanagari:
न एव अहम् राज्यम् इच्चामि न सुखम् न च मैथिलीम् |
त्वाम् अहम् सत्यम् इच्चामि न अनृतम् पुरुष ऋषभ
verses.iast:
na eva aham rājyam iccāmi na sukham na ca maithilīm |
tvām aham satyam iccāmi na anṛtam puruṣa ṛṣabha
verses.translation: "I do not crave for kingdom or happiness nor again for Seetha nor even all these enjoyments nor for heaven nor even for life."

verses.devanagari:
त्वामहम् सत्यमिच्छामि नानृतम् पुरुषर्षभ |
प्रत्यक्षम् तव सत्येन सुकृतेन च ते शपे
verses.iast:
tvāmaham satyamicchāmi nānṛtam puruśharśhabha |
pratyakśam tava satyena sukṛtena ca te śape
verses.translation: "Oh, Jewel among men! I wish you to be a truthful mean, not a fallacious man. I swear to you in your presence by truth and by virtue."

verses.devanagari:
न च शख्यम् मया तात स्थातुम् क्षणमपि प्रभो |
स शोकम् ध्रारयस्वेमम् न हि मेऽस्ति विपर्ययः
verses.iast:
na ca śakhyam mayā tāta sthātum kśaṇamapi prabho |
sa śokam dhrārayasvemam na hi me'sti viparyayaḥ
verses.translation: "It is not possible for me, Oh father, to stay on even for a moment. Therefore, contain this grief, Oh Lord, for there is no going back upon my word."

verses.devanagari:
अर्थितो ह्यस्मि कैकेय्या वनम् गच्छेति राघव |
मया चोक्तं प्रजामीति तत्सत्यमनुपालये
verses.iast:
arthito hyasmi kaikeyyā vanam gaccheti rāghava |
mayā coktaṃ prajāmīti tatsatyamanupālaye
verses.translation: "Oh Dasaratha the seion of Raghu! I was indeed asked by Kaikeyi to go to the forest. It was also replied by me that I would go. I shall redeem that pledge."

glosses.itrans: Dasaratha the seion of Raghu! asmihi
glosses.iast: ḍasaratha the seion of Raghu! asmihi
glosses.devanagari: डसरथ थे सेइओन् ओf Rअघु! अस्मिहि

glosses.meaning: to the forest." uktamcha = It was also replied

verses.devanagari:
मा चोत्कण्थां कृथा देव वने रंस्यामहे वयम् |
प्रशान्तहरिणाकीर्णे नानाशकुनिनादिते
verses.iast:
mā cotkaṇthāṃ kṛthā deva vane raṃsyāmahe vayam |
praśāntahariṇākīrṇe nānāśakuninādite
verses.translation: "Oh, king! Do not feel anxious. We shall sport in the forest, flocked with peaceful deer and rendered noisy by birds of various types."

glosses.meaning: rendered noisy by birds of various types.

verses.devanagari:
पिता हि दैवतम् तात देवतानामपि स्मृतम् |
तस्माद्दैवतमित्येव करिष्यामि पितुर्वचः
verses.iast:
pitā hi daivatam tāta devatānāmapi smṛtam |
tasmāddaivatamityeva kariśhyāmi piturvacaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, father! It was indeed said that even for celestials, father is the god. Therefore, I shall carry out the father's word, considering it as divine."

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्धशसु वर्षेषु गतेषु नरसत्तम |
पुनर्द्रक्ष्यसि माम् प्राप्तम् सन्तापोऽयम् विमुच्यताम्
verses.iast:
caturdhaśasu varśheśhu gateśhu narasattama |
punardrakśyasi mām prāptam santāpo'yam vimucyatām
verses.translation: "Oh father, the best among men! You will see me, when I come back after elapsing fourteen years. Let this grief be given up."

glosses.meaning: let this grief be given up.

verses.devanagari:
येन संस्तम्भनीयोऽयम् सर्वो बाष्पगळो जनः |
स त्वम् पुरुषशार्दूल किमर्थम् विक्रियाम् गतः
verses.iast:
yena saṃstambhanīyo'yam sarvo bāśhpagaLo janaḥ |
sa tvam puruśhaśārdūla kimartham vikriyām gataḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, tiger among men! Why have you got perturbed-you by whom all these people bathed in tears, ought to be consoled?"

glosses.meaning: are to be consoled by you

verses.devanagari:
पुरम् च राष्ट्रम् च मही च केवला |
मया निसृष्टा भरताय दीयताम् |
अहम् निदेशम् भवतः अनुपालयन् |
वनम् गमिष्यामि चिराय सेवितुम्
verses.iast:
puram ca rāṣṭram ca mahī ca kevalā |
mayā nisṛṣṭā bharatāya dīyatām |
aham nideśam bhavataḥ anupālayan |
vanam gamiṣyāmi cirāya sevitum
verses.translation: "Let this city, province and whole of this earth left by me, be given to Bharata. I for one following your instructions, shall proceed to the forest to dwell in it for long."

verses.devanagari:
मया निसृष्टाम् भरतः महीम् इमाम् |
सशैल खण्डाम् सपुराम् सकाननाम् |
शिवाम् सुसीमाम् अनुशास्तु केवलम् |
त्वया यद् उक्तम् नृपते यथा अस्तु तत्
verses.iast:
mayā nisṛṣṭām bharataḥ mahīm imām |
saśaila khaṇḍām sapurām sakānanām |
śivām susīmām anuśāstu kevalam |
tvayā yad uktam nṛpate yathā astu tat
verses.translation: "Oh, king! Let this earth with multitude of mountains, comprising of cities with their gardens relinquished by me, be ruled over barely by Bharata, within the bounds of righteousness. Let the word of honour given by you(to Kaikeyi) come true."

verses.devanagari:
न मे तथा पार्थिव धीयते मनो |
महत्सु कामेषु न च आत्मनः प्रिये |
यथा निदेशे तव शिष्ट सम्मते |
व्यपैतु दुह्खम् तव मत् कृते अनघ
verses.iast:
na me tathā pārthiva dhīyate mano |
mahatsu kāmeṣu na ca ātmanaḥ priye |
yathā nideśe tava śiṣṭa sammate |
vyapaitu duhkham tava mat kṛte anagha
verses.translation: "Oh, the faultless king! My mind is not directed on haughty physical enjoyments or sensuous pleasures which is approved by the wise. Let your agony disappear, for my sake."

verses.devanagari:
तत् अद्य न एव अनघ राज्यम् अव्ययम् |
न सर्व कामान् न सुखम् न मैथिलीम् |
न जीवितम् त्वाम् अनृतेन योजयन् |
वृणीय सत्यम् व्रतम् अस्तु ते तथा
verses.iast:
tat adya na eva anagha rājyam avyayam |
na sarva kāmān na sukham na maithilīm |
na jīvitam tvām anṛtena yojayan |
vṛṇīya satyam vratam astu te tathā
verses.translation: Oh, the sinless king! Therefore, now associating you with untruth, I just do not desire for kingdom, nor all the sensual enjoyments, nor happiness nor existence nor even Seetha. Let your pledge(given to Kaikeyi) prove true."

glosses.meaning: Oh the sinless king! tat = therefore

verses.devanagari:
फलानि मूलानि च भक्षयन् वने |
गिरीमः च पश्यन् सरितः सरांसि च |
वनम् प्रविश्य एव विचित्र पादपम् |
सुखी भविष्यामि तव अस्तु निर्वृतिः
verses.iast:
phalāni mūlāni ca bhakṣayan vane |
girīmḥ ca paśyan saritaḥ sarāṃsi ca |
vanam praviśya eva vicitra pādapam |
sukhī bhaviṣyāmi tava astu nirvṛtiḥ
verses.translation: "I shall be happy, entering the forest filled with wonderful trees, eating fruits and tubers as well as seeing mountains rivers and lakes in the forest. Let there be satisfaction for you.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् स राजा व्यसनाभिपन्नः |
शोकेन दुःखेन च ताम्यमानः |
आलिङ्ग्य पुत्रम् सुविनष्टसम्ज्ञो |
मोहम् गतो नैव चिचेश्ट किंचित्
verses.iast:
evam sa rājā vyasanābhipannaḥ |
śokena duḥkhena ca tāmyamānaḥ |
āliṇ^gya putram suvinaśhṭasamjJṇo |
moham gato naiva ciceśṭa kiṃcit
verses.translation: Embracing his son, that king Dasaratha, who had thus fallen on evil days, was tormented with grief and distress, got fainted, fully losing his consciousness and not moving even a little.

verses.devanagari:
देव्यस्ततः सम्रुरुदुः समेता |
स्ताम् वर्जयित्वा नरदेवपत्नीम् |
रुदन् सुमन्त्रोऽपि जगाम मूर्छाम् |
हा हा कृतम् तत्र बभूव सर्वम्
verses.iast:
devyastataḥ samruruduḥ sametā |
stām varjayitvā naradevapatnīm |
rudan sumantro'pi jagāma mūrchām |
hā hā kṛtam tatra babhūva sarvam
verses.translation: Then, all the queens assembled there except Kaikeyi began to cry. Sumantra also fell into a swoon, while weeping. Everything there became loud lamenting.

glosses.meaning: Kaikeyi the wife of king Dasaratha
